text:
jordan_customer: Hey team — we just linked our AWS Marketplace purchase for Dedicated nodes but the partner accelerator credits ($10k) aren't showing up in our billing/usage. Order ID: 1234-ABCD. Signed up with jordan@acme.com. Can someone check?

maria_support: Sorry about that, jordan. Looking now. Can you confirm the AWS Marketplace account ID you linked? Also what region was the AWS purchase (us-east-1, eu-west-1, etc)?

jordan_customer: Thanks. Marketplace account ID is aws-acc-9876, order region us-east-1.

marketplace-sync-bot: Order 1234-ABCD received by ingestion service at 2025-03-18T10:12:03Z. Status: queued for mapping.

maria_support: @eden_billing tagging billing/ops to check the grant job. @sophie_platform FYI — partner credit ingestion may be stuck.

eden_billing: I see the webhook and order in our queue but the promo_grant job failed during mapping. Quick log snippet:

```
ERROR [promo_grant_job] mapping_lookup failed: region_mismatch (order_region=us-east-1, account_region=eu-west-1)
Trace: promo_mapper::lookup_sku_by_marketplace
```

eden_billing: Looks like the account was created in eu-west-1 previously, so our mapping service rejected the grant. This is why credits aren't applied.

sophie_platform: Repro steps I used: 1) POSTed the webhook payload to /internal/marketplace/ingest (simulates partner). 2) Ingest returns 202 but marketplace_plan_id maps to NULL for certain region combos. 3) promo_grant job queries sku_map WHERE region = order_region and returns empty -> job aborts.

sophie_platform: Temporary workaround I ran (internal admin only):

```
# manual grant (admin)
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/admin/grant" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"account_id":"aws-acc-9876","promo_code":"aws-accelerator-2025","note":"manual grant due to region mapping bug"}'
```

sophie_platform: I just triggered a manual grant for aws-acc-9876 and filed a patch to the mapper (PR #4523) to relax region requirement for marketplace accelerator SKUs. We'll deploy the patch in the next canary (ETA ~2h) and also run a backfill job to catch any orders blocked by this issue.

maria_support: @jordan_customer we will backfill the credits within 24 hours and confirm here once applied. Apologies for the inconvenience.

jordan_customer: Appreciate the quick response. Can you post the ticket/PR numbers so my internal procurement can track?

sophie_platform: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/p/redwood/infra/pulls/4523, backfill task created: TASK-9987.

[~eden_billing] 1h later:

eden_billing: Manual grant completed and backfill job started. You should see the credit line applied to the account within a few minutes.

jordan_customer: I see the $10,000 accelerator credit on the billing page now and usage is consuming from it. Thanks everyone! :rocket:

maria_support: Great — closing the loop. If anything else shows up, reopen or ping support. :thumbsup:

sophie_platform: Added a short postmortem note in the partner-runbook and scheduled a mapper unit test for region combos.

marketplace-sync-bot: Notification: TASK-9987 backfill job completed for aws-acc-9876. Credits applied: 10000 USD (promo: aws-accelerator-2025).

jordan_customer: Confirmed final — all good on our side. Thank you.
